auto_mount_dir.description: Path to where a volume to be auto unlocked/mounted is located. Corresponds to -d.

file_manager_tool.description: Tool to use to open a default file manager. Corresponds to -m.

pw_backend.description: Backend to retrieve a password from. Supported: internal, stdin, keyfile, kwallet, libsecret. Corresponds to -b.

default_mode.description: Default mode for opening volumes. 'rw' for read/write, 'ro' for read-only. Corresponds to -k.

mount_point.description: Full path of the mount point to be used when the volume is opened from CLI. Corresponds to -z.

volume_config_path.description: Set Volume Configuration File Path when a volume is opened from CLI. Corresponds to -c.

inactive_timeout.description: Inactivity timeout (in minutes) to dismount the volume when mounted from CLI. Corresponds to -i.

mount_options.description: Set mount options when mounting a volume from CLI. Corresponds to -o.

headless_mode.description: Start the application without showing the GUI. Corresponds to -e.
